svg.text: Safety mechanisms covered by the suite
Six core safeguarding patterns. Each is the subject of a builder + reviewer pair.

g.text: Sp = Sh + Sr + Ss + C + Zd + Zr
Lidar / vision detect intrusion; robot slows or stops before contact.
CoboSafe / Pilz PRMS / KUKA force test rigs validate per body region.
Two diverse channels with cross-monitoring achieve Cat 3 / PL d.
Sp = K · (T1 + T2) + C ; minimum distance per ISO 13855 stopping perf.
One lock per authorized employee · group lockout for shared isolation.
FR 1-7 mapped to per-zone SL-T; conduits enforce protocol allowlists.
